cs.t: I'm always curious - what are people doing with their lightning cables? I've had apple devices for over 10 years now, my house is littered with lightning cables everywhere, and they are all in perfect shape. No fraying, no problems with the plug, nothing. Can't say the same about some USB-C cables I bought, pretty much anything that isn't Anker just stops making a contact after few months.

I hate USB-C connectors. All my phones have had the same issue: USB-C connector busts and you can't insert the cable any more. I use high quality Anker cables, and I keep having to buy new Google Pixels over this. Replacing the USB-C port is around $160.
